"},"content":{"type":"html","$t":"\u003Cdiv\u003Ehttps:\/\/soumyamenda80.blogspot.com\/2023\/11\/29-year-old-with-bilateral-lower-limb.html\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E1.How NSAID abuse effects on kidney leading to renal injury and How long exposure and dosage can cause injury\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThe main mechanism of NSAID action is cyclooxygenase (COX) enzyme inhibition, interfering on arachidonic acid conversion into E2 prostaglandins E2, prostacyclins and thromboxanes. Within the kidneys, prostaglandins act as vasodilators, increasing renal perfusion. This vasodilatation is a counter regulation of mechanisms, such as the renin-angiotensin-aldosterone system works and that of the sympathetic nervous system, culminating with compensation to ensure adequate flow to the organ. NSAIDs inhibit this mechanism and can lead to acute kidney injury (AKI).\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; text-align: center;\"\u003E\n \u003Ca href=\"https:\/\/blogger.googleusercontent.com\/img\/a\/AVvXsEiqGiiOS0hNqP8U-yRBCc7CrkAnxE8GTxknwgMwlGUl0j_yEzLX5FgY9RL1Gzw9BDaKD2Q6Aigv8ZavAIoJt5aaEsp-x9x04XzIWhEnJVZPmAO4q19uq3AGj6pb3xhExh8QrRwXjqEHU3vGB8MR_xAyZIt85BHyL9FBN03rqaNZchs4aXk7yikkeJzRNSI\" imageanchor=\"1\" style=\"margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;\"\u003E\n \u003Cimg border=\"0\" src=\"https:\/\/blogger.googleusercontent.com\/img\/a\/AVvXsEiqGiiOS0hNqP8U-yRBCc7CrkAnxE8GTxknwgMwlGUl0j_yEzLX5FgY9RL1Gzw9BDaKD2Q6Aigv8ZavAIoJt5aaEsp-x9x04XzIWhEnJVZPmAO4q19uq3AGj6pb3xhExh8QrRwXjqEHU3vGB8MR_xAyZIt85BHyL9FBN03rqaNZchs4aXk7yikkeJzRNSI\" width=\"400\"\u003E\n \u003C\/a\u003E\n\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003Ehttps:\/\/www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov\/pmc\/articles\/PMC6534025\/\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E2.What other drugs or treatment modalities could be possible other than NSAIDs for pain?\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHe had history of Rat poison ,does it have any significance in etiopathogenesis of the condition\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003Ehttps:\/\/pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov\/28545504\/\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThis is a case report showing renal damage\u0026nbsp; of 35 year old female consume rat poison - zinc phosphide compound\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EShe developed severe acute kidney injury with acute tubular necrosis, subnephrotic ranged proteinuria and tubulointerstitial nephritis for which she underwent haemodialysis three times along with other measures of resuscitation.\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHere Zinc phosphide poisoning caused severe acute kidney injury, abnormal liver profile, pancreatitis and possible myocarditis. The patient improved with repeated haemodialysis. The renal biopsy revealed acute tubulointerstitial nephritis with acute tubular necrosis\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E3.Previous his leg pain was relieved on medication ,recently no pain relief even after NSAID\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENow after dialysis the pain is relived ,is it due\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EDecreased uric acid levels? If so how much uric acid can be eliminated by dialysis and what could be long term treatment for the pain (which is one of his problem to be addressed in long term)\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHere is link of study of NSAIDs exposure effects\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003Ehttps:\/\/bpspubs.onlinelibrary.wiley.com\/doi\/10.1002\/prp2.817\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThere are not many studies showing the long-term effects of NSAIDs on the development of CKD. However, Melgaco et al. reported, that daily use of NSAIDs for over a year increases the risk of developing CKD.Patients who continue to use NSAIDs may progress to the already existing weakened kidney function, contributing to their fibrosis.\u0026nbsp;A recent cohort study by Chiu et al. published in 2015\u0026nbsp;showed that in the elderly, chronically ill patients, regardless of the class and selectivity of the drug, NSAIDs increase the risk of CKD in a dose-dependent matter. Among over 12 thousand patients who had comorbidities but were using NSAIDs about 10% of them developed CKD.The result was statistically significant.\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E"},"link":[{"rel":"edit","type":"application/atom+xml","href":"https:\/\/www.blogger.com\/feeds\/4009072451286972333\/posts\/default\/8462722043701262398"},{"rel":"self","type":"application/atom+xml","href":"https:\/\/www.blogger.com\/feeds\/4009072451286972333\/posts\/default\/8462722043701262398"},{"rel":"alternate","type":"text/html","href":"https:\/\/soumyamenda80.blogspot.com\/2023\/12\/osce-questions.html","title":"OSCE questions "}],"author":[{"name":{"$t":"80 Soumya Menda"},"uri":{"$t":"http:\/\/www.blogger.com\/profile\/00588421328774243383"},"email":{"$t":"noreply@blogger.com"},"gd$image":{"rel":"http://schemas.google.com/g/2005#thumbnail","width":"16","height":"16","src":"https:\/\/img1.blogblog.com\/img\/b16-rounded.gif"}}],"media$thumbnail":{"xmlns$media":"http://search.yahoo.com/mrss/","url":"https:\/\/blogger.googleusercontent.com\/img\/a\/AVvXsEiqGiiOS0hNqP8U-yRBCc7CrkAnxE8GTxknwgMwlGUl0j_yEzLX5FgY9RL1Gzw9BDaKD2Q6Aigv8ZavAIoJt5aaEsp-x9x04XzIWhEnJVZPmAO4q19uq3AGj6pb3xhExh8QrRwXjqEHU3vGB8MR_xAyZIt85BHyL9FBN03rqaNZchs4aXk7yikkeJzRNSI=s72-c","height":"72","width":"72"}},{"id":{"$t":"tag:blogger.com,1999:blog-4009072451286972333.post-6415854493300332616"},"published":{"$t":"2023-11-30T08:48:00.000-08:00"},"updated":{"$t":"2023-12-01T01:03:03.807-08:00"},"title":{"type":"text","$t":"29 year old with bilateral lower limb pain"},"content":{"type":"html","$t":"\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp; I am Soumya 9th semester student .\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThis is an e-LOG depicting patient's de-identified data centered approach for learning medicine.
